Not wanting her implants to enter the room before she did, this young mom reached out to our practice to discuss a subtle low profile change.  As we are known for subtle enhancements, she was in the right place for her breast augmentation.   During her hour long consultation with Dr. Camp they discussed her active lifestyle, exercise habits, and work life.  Understanding this and her goal for an "under the radar" surgery they decided upon Allergan 250cc low profile silicone gel gummy bear implants.  Her vision was further solidified through the use of Vectra 3D imaging. 

Her surgery was performed at an accredited outpatient surgery facility under the care of Dr. Camp and a board certified anesthesiologist.  Her surgery took about 30 minutes and allowed her to recover at home just a few hours later.  Because of Dr. Camp's expertise in non-traumatic surgery she was able to go out to dinner the night of her surgery and complained of almost no pain.  She returned to work in just 3 days. 

Her post-operative pictures were captured 3 months after surgery.
